findings.detail: The de-duplication is real — `sr-only` does not remove the live region's text from the accessibility tree, so the help paragraph was reachable twice. But the fix drops the actionable half of the announcement rather than the duplicate. After pressing Test, a screen-reader user now hears only `t.actions.noModel` ("No model"), and `t.actions.noModelHelp` — the text that names `services/geminiService.ts` and the `scripts/list-gemini-models.mjs` command — lives solely in the visible panel at :130, which is not a live region and therefore is not announced on the status change. The user has to already suspect there is more detail and go browse for it. Both goals are achievable: keep the detail in the announcement and remove the duplicate from the other side. Raising this to medium would require the help text to be the only path to recovery, which it isn't (it is still browsable), which is why it is low.
findings.summary: no-model remediation text is no longer announced, only the badge
